title: About Me
text:
Connect with me


  
  



Hello! I’m a Business Marketing Manager in the public media nonprofit sector. I’ve spent most of my professional career focused on financial operations and budget management. I currently work on a Direct Mail Marketing Strategy Team, where I build dashboards and use data to support strategic initiatives.
I’m working toward a Master of Science (MS) in Applied Business Analytics at Boston University. I discovered data analytics in 2020 and was immediately drawn to the process of turning data into meaningful and actionable insights. As I continue developing my analytical skills, I’m interested in pursuing opportunities where I can combine strategy, marketing, and data analytics to help organizations make better decisions and create value.
I’m a gigging guitarist and a hiking enthusiast. I’ve explored many destinations, including most of California’s National Parks, and enjoy bringing that same sense of curiosity and discovery to life outside of work.
